note: Requests the route check asks after its GET questions, one at a time and in this order, to an engine before a move and to the one after it: routes that write, with a GET here and there to read back what was written. Add a route only after reading the lines under its test: it must touch nothing but the data folder of the throwaway copy. The copy can start no program and reach nothing (routes-quiet.cjs), but nothing stops a call into Windows itself or a file written outside the copy, so never a route that acts on the PC: locking it, volume, lights, windows, a file opened, moved or deleted, a Deck key, an install.
